title: ELVES current warranty terms
notes: Official policy gives the original, non-transferable owner 5-year coverage for frame manufacturing/material defects and 1-year coverage for parts; receipt or proof of purchase is required. Misuse, impact, improper assembly and similar exclusions apply. The policy is frame-kit/component-class support, not proof that a particular R7170 complete-bike purchase is eligible or that a mainland claim route is available.
